subject: Invitation to Exclusive Summer Sale Event
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to invite you to our exclusive Summer Sale Event happening this weekend! Enjoy up to 50% off on select items and get a sneak peek at our latest collection. Don't miss out on this opportunity to refresh your wardrobe for the season. Join us at our store located at 123 Main Street on Saturday from 10am to 6pm. We look forward to seeing you there!
